Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Dr.Kamal Deo Sharma, Adv
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Singh, APP

For the Informant Mr. Nirbhay Prashant, Adv  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH  ORAL ORDER 3 07-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.
2. Petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with Simri P.S.Case No. 245 of 2024 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. As per the prosecution case, the co-accused persons have deliberately and fraudulently taken an amount of Rs. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.47327 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 1,5000/- on the pretext of marriage of informant's daughter with co- accused Mitlesh Tiwari, thereafter the accused persons neither returned that money nor agreed to the marriage.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that FIR has been lodged after much delay of more than eight months and no explanation has been given for such delay.
It is further submitted that the informant has neither paid money or gift nor return the money or gift to the petitioners.
The informant's daughter had married to somewhere else.

There is no witness and documentary Mithlesh Tiwari @ Mithilesh Tiwari vs The State Of Bihar on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167476328/
1 evidence in support of the prosecution case.

sentences.text: 5. Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, and also taking into consideration the materials available on record, the petitioners above named, in the event of their arrest/ surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of this order, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Buxar in connection with Simri P.S.Case No.
245 of 2024, subject to condition as laid down under Section 482(2) Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.47327 of 2025(3) dt.07-11-2025 of the BNSS, and further condition is that one of the bailors should be close relative of the petitioner.

(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) N.K/-
